HOT  -> delta_winpct >= +0.200 (surging).
COLD -> delta_winpct <= -0.200 (sliding).
OK   -> between those bands (steady).
Last10/Prior10: win/loss records for the latest vs previous window.
delta_winpct: difference between those win percentages.
Streak: active run of consecutive wins/losses (sign denotes W/L).
Conf-Div: conference/division combo (e.g., N-E).

blowout_resilience.entry: Regular-season only: shows how often each club thrives in 5+ run decisions and how big those wins typically are.
Meaning: higher win% and positive margin in blowouts signal resiliency when games get lopsided.
Team                   CD   Tag           Blowouts    Win%  AvgDiff   Share      Overall
Blowout game: decided by 5+ runs (abs(runs_for - runs_against) >= 5).
Share = blowout games / total games; AvgDiff = mean run differential in blowouts.

bullpen_stress.entry: Last-14/7-day bullpen workload snapshot: innings per game, back-to-back usage, and high-leverage share.
Meaning: higher stress scores flag pens carrying heavier loads and potential fatigue risk; inherited runner data adds season-long context.

Critical >=3.0 | High 2.5-2.99 | Moderate 2.0-2.49 | Manageable <2.0 (Unknown if data gaps).
Stress14/7 = composite bullpen strain over last 14 / last 7 days.
IP/G14 (IP/G7) = bullpen innings per team game across last 14 (7) days.
B2B14 (B2B7) = share of relief appearances made on back-to-back days in last 14 (7) days.
HiLev14 (HiLev7) = share of outings with leverage index >=1.5 or marked SV/HLD/GF/save-sit.
IR/IRS% = season-long inherited runners and their scoring rate from the sortable pitching report.
Stress Index = IP/G + 0.5*B2B Rate + 0.5*High-Leverage Share (higher = more strain).
Windows always reference the anchor_date-based last-14 and last-7 day periods.
